title: An operator rolls out a Papyrus update to the client's account
description:
The managed offer is that we orchestrate updates over time.

```gherkin
Feature: Operated update

  Scenario: An update is applied and checked
    Given a new Papyrus release that affects sites
    When the operator rolls it out to the deployment
    Then the deployment runs the new version
    And the sites are checked afterwards
    And the client's account shows who did it
```
